scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w apps/server" "npm run dev -w apps/client"
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/shared --noEmit && tsc -p apps/server --noEmit && tsc -p apps/client --noEmit
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/server && npm run build -w apps/client
